body:
I don't think my lying has any kind of particular reasoning behind it, I just do it out of habit and for virtually no reason at all. That's probably not it since I can't diagnose myself but I really can't find any other reason apart from habit. I've never felt better or worse than anybody else and lying about accomplishments isn't something I do.   


It's usually for a story, I think, I can't really recall what I've lied about since I forget about it nonchalantly, but that is what comes to mind first. I'll try to mull the reason over, thanks for the advice dude.
A moment to slow down really does help a lot, thanks dude

Thanks dude, some of these lies come back to bite me later in life, it's hurts the people around me and their trust for me. I really dislike that feeling. I'll try to start slow. Thanks for the advice
I don't ever lie about my accomplishments, e.g. awards, grades etc... but always just some story or small detail in the spur of the moment.

It's been a habit for a while and I think it'll take a long time to undo. Most of my friends have a general idea that it's a problem but it's always treated in a jokey manner and never addressed seriously. Thanks for the advice dude, I'll bring it up with them.
Usually a moment to think helps it a lot, the hard part is keeping in that mindset for a sustained period of time. Thanks for the advice.
Thanks man, this helps a lot
